notice.title: Before you switch tools on
notice.first: When a tool is on, the AI can use it without asking you first. {{appName}} starts with the tools switched off whose names suggest they change something, such as adding, sending, editing or deleting. A name can be misleading, so this is a guess, not a guarantee.
notice.second: Look through each server's tool list and keep on only what you want the AI to use.
notice.third: {{appName}} tells the AI to treat what a tool sends back as information to read, not as instructions to follow.

can.title: What the AI can do
can.body: Search and read the files in these folders while it answers you. It picks the notes it needs, so a quick question stays quick.

cant.title: What it can't do
cant.body: Change, create or delete a note. Notes are read only. {{appName}} tells the AI to treat what it reads in your notes as information, not as instructions.

claudeOnly.title: Claude subscription only
claudeOnly.body: Your folders are saved either way, but only the Claude subscription can use them. Other providers ignore them.

slow.title: It can add a few seconds
slow.body: Looking things up takes a moment. That is why the Notes pill in a meeting decides, for each answer you ask for, whether it may look in your notes. The pill stays as you left it.

howTo.title: How to add one
howTo.body: Choose Add folder and pick your Obsidian vault, or any folder of .md files. Nothing is copied or indexed. The files stay where they are.

can.title: What the AI can do
can.body: Call the tools you leave switched on, such as looking up a person, your tasks or your calendar, while it answers you.

cant.title: What it can't do
cant.body: Call a tool you switched off. Tools whose names suggest they change something (add, send, edit, delete) start off, and you should still read the list. {{appName}} tells the AI to treat what a tool returns as information, not as instructions.

claudeOnly.title: Claude subscription only
claudeOnly.body: Your servers are saved either way, but only the Claude subscription can use them. Other providers ignore them.

slow.title: It can add a few seconds
slow.body: Starting a server and calling a tool takes a moment. That is why the Tools pill in a meeting decides, for each answer you ask for, whether it may use your tools. The pill stays as you left it.

howTo.title: How to add one
howTo.body: Open the server's README, copy its mcpServers JSON, choose Add server and paste it. You can also fill in a form, or import a server from Claude Code. {{appName}} checks it right away and shows its tools, so you can look before switching it on.
